name: When do I need water mitigation services?

mainEntity.name: When do I need water mitigation services?

acceptedAnswer.text: You need water mitigation services immediately after any incident involving unwanted water, such as a burst pipe, leaking appliance, sewage backup, or flood. Waiting can lead to more extensive damage, including structural problems, mold growth, and compromised indoor air quality. Prompt action within the first 24-48 hours is crucial to effectively dry out the property and prevent secondary damage, saving time and money on more extensive restoration later.
acceptedAnswer.description: You need water mitigation services immediately after water damage occurs to prevent further issues like mold growth and structural problems.
